editions.name: Game is Life 2.0
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star hoards 6,110 coins yet bleeds 63 today — poetic. @here scrapes 63 gains and survives a 2,000 bounty, keeping 500. Caravan Collective misses targets while BELL debuts at 37.24. Fog blankets the realm. The throne sits empty. Rebellion stirs at twenty percent. Mortals call this prosperity. I call it Tuesday.
